name: VQE Hydrogen Molecule Ground State
description: Benchmark of the Variational Quantum Eigensolver algorithm for computing the ground state energy of the hydrogen molecule (H2). This is a standard benchmark for hybrid quantum-classical chemistry simulations, testing the interplay between quantum circuit evaluation and classical optimization.
significance: The 'hello world' of quantum chemistry — the simplest meaningful molecular simulation, used universally to validate new VQE implementations and hardware.

news.title: IBM and Algorithmiq Demonstrate Trusted Quantum Advantage for Molecular Ground-State Simulation
news.excerpt: IBM and Algorithmiq report that their quantum simulation of molecular ground states has withstood classical competition for eight months on the IBM Quantum Advantage Tracker. Algorithmiq released its best classical molecular ground-state simulation method as an open benchmark package.
